title: Expansion-band stretcher
summary: An open cleaning drum with reinforced sockets, diagonal braces, and interchangeable band-retaining inserts.

sections.title: A stronger drum for the same inserts
sections.text: Revision 3 supports 23 mm of the insert spine in stepped sockets, with 26 mm rear walls and 4 mm side walls. The low front wall leaves the largest band opening clear. The diagonal frame and thicker rims carry over from Revision 2. Existing inserts still fit: only the drum needs a new print.

sections.title: Choose your files
sections.text: Print drum.stl upright as supplied. Use slot_inserts_16-20mm.stl for all five pairs, including 19 mm. Split the file into objects in your slicer to print just the pair you need. The editable OpenSCAD file opens as an assembly; export the separate parts for printing.

sections.title: Printing & use
sections.text: Start with 0.2 mm layers, four perimeters, and solid inserts. Inspect the upper-rim bridges and brace junctions in your slicer. Match the slot to the band body and wider end fittings, smooth every contact edge, and check bath clearance and filament compatibility. The 254 mm reference arc is not a guaranteed stretched band length.

status: Prototype. Revision 3 passed the supplied mesh and CAD clearance checks but has not been physically tested. Strength, fit, and cleaning performance still need confirmation.

title: Bracelet sizing cones
summary: Tapered sizing tools for watch bands and bracelets, with arrows, oval, round, and original variants.

sections.title: Pick the variant that suits your bench
sections.text: The collection includes the arrows, oval, and round inch variants, an inch sizing cone, and the original sizing cone. All nine original model files are preserved, including the additional oval 3MF copy.

sections.title: Before printing
sections.text: Open an STL or 3MF in your slicer and review orientation, scale, printer, and filament settings. Variant names come from the source filenames. Measurement accuracy and print settings have not been validated; check against a known measurement before using the cone for sizing.

status: Original model collection. Preview images are mesh renders, not photographs of finished prints. Dimensions and sizing calibration have not been validated.

title: Cedarburg house & garage
summary: A photo-interpreted house and detached garage, split into printable walls and roofs for a model railway or diorama.

sections.title: Two buildings, four printable parts
sections.text: Print the four numbered STL parts or use the two geometry-only 3MF plates. The roofs lift off for painting and assembly. The rear house entry sits beneath the balcony. Assembled-reference STLs are included for digital inspection; they are not additional kit parts.

sections.title: Printing & assembly
sections.text: Import in millimeters at 100% scale; the parts are already HO size. Select your own printer and filament profiles. The documented MK3.5 validation used a 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.10 mm layers, three perimeters, and 10% infill. Use snug supports for the house roof. Follow PRINT_GUIDE.md for supports, dry-fitting, and painting.

sections.title: Editable, photo-based architecture
sections.text: The Python generator and dimensions.json are included. Building dimensions were estimated from photographs with assumed garage-door dimensions as a scale reference. Windows and doors are recessed closed surfaces for painting, and fine features are thickened for FDM printing.

status: The supplied validation records report watertight meshes and successful MK3.5 slicing. No physical print has been tested. Dimensions are photo-estimated, not surveyed.

title: Watch-cleaning baskets
summary: A basket, rotor, spindle, and tray collection, with Beau’s added holes and extra spacer plate.
byline: Originals: gpraceman, based on muddtt. Modifications: Beau Gosse.

license.name: Originals: CC BY-NC 4.0 · Modifications: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
license.summary: Credit gpraceman, muddtt, and Beau Gosse; noncommercial use. Original notices are preserved.

images.label: Original V3 basket
images.credit: Render of gpraceman’s STL · CC BY-NC 4.0

sections.title: Original design and Beau’s changes
sections.text: gpraceman’s Watch Cleaning Baskets refines muddtt’s Pearl watch-cleaning designs. Beau added more holes and an extra spacer plate. The download keeps the original set, source images, README, and license alongside Beau’s local 3MF and STEP working files. The main photograph shows gpraceman’s original set.

sections.title: Choose original meshes or modified projects
sections.text: The files folder holds all 13 original STL meshes: basket variants, compartment trays, mini-basket holders, rotor, spindle, jar holder, and fan parts. The four 3MF projects and half-basket-meshed4.step are Beau’s supplied working files. Some projects contain both original and modified parts. The original Thingiverse ZIP is also available separately.

sections.title: Open the 3MF projects in a compatible slicer
sections.text: Some local projects use negative volumes to make holes. Inspect the sliced result: a plain STL export can omit those cutouts. Use bottom plate.3mf for the supplied spacer-plate project, and review the other projects before selecting the parts you need.

sections.title: Original designer’s printing notes
sections.text: gpraceman lists ABS, 0.2 mm layers, 25% infill, no supports, and a brim as starting settings, with higher infill for the extension spindle. The rotor uses a 3 mm threaded insert and screw. The mini-basket holder is sized around 24 × 22 mm baskets. These are the original designer’s settings, not a validation of Beau’s modified parts.

sections.title: Meshed tray bottoms need slicer settings
sections.text: For applicable trays, the original Cura recipe uses zero top and bottom layers, triangles infill, 3.0 mm line distance, line multiplier 2, and connected infill lines and polygons. Follow the original listing and inspect toolpaths; downloading the STL alone does not reproduce those settings.

sources.label: Watch Cleaning Baskets — gpraceman on Thingiverse
Original Pearl rotor — muddtt on Printables
Original Pearl basket — muddtt on Printables

status: Check machine fit, moving-part clearance, and material compatibility with your cleaner before use. Beau’s modified files have not been physically validated as part of this publication. Original photos show the source designer’s prints.

title: Mahjong line reader aid
summary: A slim reading aid with a long line opening and a recessed face, saved as an editable PrusaSlicer project.

sections.title: Keep your place on a Mahjong card
sections.text: Beau’s original design uses a long, narrow opening to isolate a line while reading. The file contains the base and two subtractive boxes that form the opening and recessed region.

sections.title: Print from the original 3MF
sections.text: Open Mahjong Line Reader Aid.3mf in PrusaSlicer or a slicer that supports its negative volumes. Check the sliced preview to confirm the opening and recess are present. The original 3MF is provided because a plain STL export can lose the subtractive features.

sections.title: Check card fit before printing
sections.text: The saved project is approximately 165 × 90 × 8 mm, with a 140 × 6 mm line opening. Those dimensions come from the file geometry. Review your card’s layout, the project’s printer and filament settings, and the first layer before printing.

status: The preview shows the actual box geometry after applying both negative volumes. It is a model render, not a photograph of a print. Physical print performance and fit to a particular Mahjong card have not been validated.

title: Hoyer 6000 series bezel
summary: A two-piece replacement bezel with mirrored halves, smooth convex terminals, and dimensions tuned for a Hoyer 6000-series watch.

sections.title: A replacement bezel for the Hoyer 6000 series
sections.text: The bezel is split into two mirrored halves that follow the dial while leaving the side openings clear. Filled transitions join the circular rim to the wider end sections, and each far edge rounds continuously down to the terminal floor.

sections.title: Print two copies of the half
sections.text: watch_bezel_half.stl is the printable master; print it twice and rotate one copy 180 degrees around the dial. watch_bezel_assembly.stl shows the intended relationship between both pieces. The OpenSCAD source is included for dimensional adjustments.

sections.title: Check fit before final use
sections.text: The modeled opening is 32.9 mm, the circular outside diameter and terminal shoulder span are both 35.5 mm, and the side separation is 9.3 mm. Import at 100% in millimeters, inspect the sliced result, and test the prototype gently against the watch.

status: Prototype. The latest revision is watertight and passed the supplied digital dimension checks, but physical fit of the 32.9 mm opening and 35.5 mm terminal-shoulder revision has not yet been confirmed.
